RIVER CARD // THE WHY

THE STORY
BEHIND THE BET.

PokerVision was created by me alongside Allen Xu, Aiden Xie, and Andres Nino. As betting became an increasingly visible part of our generation’s culture, we wanted to explore what a real-time “cheat code” could look like: a computer-vision system that reads the table and turns what it sees into an immediate decision.

FOUR BUILDERS // ONE TABLE

TRAINING MODE

Built for sandbox, replay, and explicitly consented demonstrations — not covert real-money play.

UNDER THE FELT // SYSTEM PIPELINE

HOW THE TABLE
BECOMES A MOVE.

PokerVision is a complete loop: see the table, stabilize what was seen, solve the spot, and return one glanceable action to the display.

01 // CAPTURE

STREAM THE TABLE.

Meta Wearables DAT streams frames from the glasses camera into the active Swift iOS app, with phone and captured-frame fallbacks for testing.

MWDAT CAMERA · SWIFT
02 // DETECT

FIND EVERY CARD.

A YOLOv8 model runs through Apple Vision and Core ML, returning card labels, confidence scores, bounding boxes, and hero-versus-board zones.

YOLOV8 · VISION · CORE ML
03 // STABILIZE

TRUST MORE THAN ONE FRAME.

Detections are fused across multiple observations. The hand only advances when two hero cards, a valid board, and every visible card are identified confidently.

STATE FUSION · CONFIDENCE GATE
04 // SOLVE

CALL THE DECISION LAYER.

On the current GitHub main branch, the app sends structured card state to a FastAPI endpoint. Chen scoring handles preflop strength; Monte Carlo equity and pot odds guide postflop actions.

CURRENT MAIN · FASTAPI · TREYS
05 // DISPLAY

SHOW ONLY THE NEXT MOVE.

The glasses receive a compact action such as CHECK, CALL, or RAISE, while the phone remains the debug mirror for detections, confidence warnings, and raw solver state.

DAT DISPLAY · PHONE DEBUG UI
THE RULE UNCLEAR TABLE? DON’T GUESS.

Low-confidence reads return “Look again” instead of manufacturing a recommendation.
